prompts.name: command-ring-kinetic
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: polished 16:9 video-game story background, 2048x1152 or greater. Input image 1 is the edit target: preserve its overall perspective, location, engineering layout and specific narrative situation. Input image 2 is STYLE AND COLOR reference only: use ink-blue structural contours, broad painted color shapes and one or two hard cel shadow steps; do NOT copy its robots, game interface, labels or text. Repaint in confident hand-drawn heroic mecha anime background art (KINETIC_CEL), precise coherent load-bearing geometry, modern industrial megacity. Steel teal and warm concrete ivory, small vermilion painted elements and mustard hardware, deep blue structural shadows. Clear soft daylight with a quiet sky, distinct near and far layers. Surface character comes from intentional panel shapes, seams and crisp construction, not dirt noise. Keep mechanically logical bridge, train, rails, building and coupler proportions. No medieval buildings. No photorealism, PBR, grainy rust, photographic water glints, excessive tiny windows/highlights, bloom, plastic toys or washed-out white masses. No added UI, no captions, no logos, no readable or invented lettering. No extra people or robots. Preserve the broad waterfront panorama of the edit target: power installation to left, raised disconnected railway bridge in the middle, station and rescue train on right, huge elevated loop and modern towers in the distance. Preserve the disrupted connection as the central story fact. Keep raised bridge sections readable with actual hinges and piers; retain the small hostile insects as minor red silhouettes at the lower edges. Title menu will occupy left 38 percent; keep the center-right broken bridge the focus. This should feel like a colorful, composed anime establishing shot, not a photographic screenshot.

prompts.name: story-link-kinetic
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: 16:9 game story background, 2048x1152. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the already repainted establishing shot of THE SAME LOCATION and determines style, palette and daylight. Repaint image 1 to match image 2: crisp ink-blue structural contours, broad teal/ivory/vermilion industrial paint, one or two hard cel-shading steps, clear daylight, modern heroic mecha anime environment, low texture noise. Preserve the original narrative change: the cyan power conduits along the left building and bridge are now energised, visibly but with very little bloom. Preserve train on right, raised broken bridge in center and the load-bearing piers, and engineering-city skyline. Build a readable scene of power being restored; do not invent a fully repaired bridge, do not change construction/perspective into a different city. Include no HUD, words, logos or characters. Match image 2's line work and daylight, not image 1's night photography and dense specular lights. Remove micro rust/noisy windows. Do not overexpose ivory walls or make all surfaces cyan. 16:9 crop with essential bridge and left conduit visible.
